code.hello: {{fn}} is missing one line where the comment is. Write it and press "Run & check". Tap me if you need me.
code.lastHint: OK, here's the line: {{line}} Try to understand it before copying.
code.noMore: That was the last hint. The line is in hint 3.
code.banned: Nope, {{banned}} isn't allowed here. Write the solution yourself, like the book.
code.syntax: There is a typo in the code: {{message}}. Check brackets and semicolons.
code.missing: I can't find a function called {{fn}}. Make sure you didn't rename it.

code.unsupported: This browser won't run code here. Try another browser.

home.title: Your whole course, but as a game
home.lead: Every lesson is a short stage: get the idea, try it with your hands, and earn points. Beto, your robot buddy, helps you all the way. CodeLab complements Qureo; it doesn't replace it.
home.footer: CodeLab · complements Qureo · content from the ministry textbook "Programming and AI", Baccalaureate Year 1

ways.title: Every lesson is taught the way that fits it
ways.sub: Same structure as the book: Key Points, Test Your Knowledge, Try It Yourself, Exercise.
ways.cards: One idea per page, with the book's examples and page number, and Beto explaining it simply.
ways.scenarios: A real-life situation where you pick the right action, for ethics, law and security.
ways.tools: Bulbs you switch on and numbers you build by hand so the idea sticks.
ways.code: Write real JavaScript that runs and gets checked right in front of you.

book.label: Explainer book, use the arrow keys to turn pages
book.keys: Turn pages with the buttons, the folded corner, the dots, or the arrow keys.
book.binaryHint: Only two digits, like a bulb
book.readUp: Read the remainders bottom to top

reaction.wrong: No worries, mistakes teach. Read the book's answer and try again.
reaction.poke: I'm here! If something isn't clear, tap "Explain it again".

book.hexTry: Try it: type any binary number (only 0 and 1)
book.charTry: Try it: type a word in English
book.compTry: Try it: type any binary number (only 0 and 1)
book.rgbNote: Each colour = 8 bits, so all three together = 24 bits (3 × 8)
book.rleTry: Try it: type English letters (for example AAAABBB)
book.mapHint: Tap any part to see what it does.
book.logicHint: Tap A and B to flip the value (0 or 1) and see the result.
book.ipTry: Try it: type an IP address (4 numbers separated by dots)
book.ipNote: Each number from 0 to 255 = 8 bits, so the whole address is 32 bits (4 × 8).
book.shapesHint: Tap any shape to see its kind.

db.name: Student name
db.recordNote: A row (record) = all of one student's data: code, name and club.
db.fieldNote: A column (field) = one kind of data for every student, like the student name.

game.sideText: Each bulb has a value: 128, 64, 32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1. A bulb that is on = 1, off = 0. Switch on the bulbs that add up to the target.
